name: site-creator-vinext-starter
description: TOPFIRE 衡绩员工绩点考核系统 - 桌面离线版
author: 邹富敦 (Phudon Zou) / TOPFIRE 研发团队

scripts.test: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && node tests/core.test.mjs && node tests/auditor.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('app/favicon.ico','build/icon.ico'); fs.copyFileSync('app/icon.png','build/icon.png');" && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts
scripts.desktop:start: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && node tests/core.test.mjs && node tests/auditor.test.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron-builder --win nsis msi portable && node scripts/build-zip.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack:portable: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.desktop:pack:installer: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron-builder --win nsis msi
scripts.desktop:pack:signed: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && electron-builder --win portable --config.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.pages:build: node scripts/check-hooks.mjs && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('build/desktop/desktop.html', 'build/desktop/index.html');"

build.productName: 衡绩员工绩点考核系统

nsis.shortcutName: 衡绩员工绩点考核系统

msi.shortcutName: 衡绩员工绩点考核系统
